preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain ownership through transferOwnership/nominatePotentialOwner/acceptOwnership)

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the mint() function with your address as the recipient and an arbitrary amount to mint new tokens. This will increase your token balance and the total supply, causing token inflation. The function is onlyOwner protected, so you must either be the current owner or gain ownership through the ownership transfer mechanisms first.
